<div class="card-body">
'''Tactical Support''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">戦術支援部隊</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">1フォース失って自分のリザーブデッキから最大3枚の兵員／トルーパーを探し出し、手札に入れる。その後リザーブデッキはシャッフルし、カットしてもとの所に置く。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Tactical-Support-PSA-85187812.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">高度な訓練を受けた帝国軍の歩兵部隊は驚異的な速度で進軍し、敵の不意をついて一方的に攻撃することができる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tactical Support.

'''Card text:'''
Lose 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck for up to 3 personnel or troopers and take them into hand. Then shuffle and cut the Reserve Deck and return it to its place.

'''Lore:'''
Highly trained Imperial infantry units can advance at astonishing speed and attack one-sidedly by catching the enemy off guard.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The printed title is Tactical Support Unit (戦術支援部隊).
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tactical Support]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
